product.name: Regular Fit Wool-Blend Bomber Jacket
product.description: Regular-fit bomber jacket in a soft wool blend with a comfortable, classic silhouette. Stand-up collar, zipper at front with wind flap and snap fasteners, and a yoke at back. Side pockets, an inner pocket, and ribbing at collar, cuffs, and hem. Lined.

materialDetails.name: Recycled wool
